news.title: Reds Duo Named In CommBank Joeys Squad for the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026™
news.lede: Veart has selected a squad with a blend of emerging talent and players gaining valuable senior football experience, as Australia prepares to compete on the world stage for the first time since the FIFA U-17 World Cup Brazil 2019™, where the CommBank Joeys progressed to the Round of 16. Australia secured its place at the tournament following a strong campaign at the AFC U17 Asian Cup Saudi Arabia 2026™, advancing to the semi-finals for the first time since 2018, highlighted by a 3-0 quarter-final victory over Vietnam. The squad retains a strong core of players from that campaign, complemented by those who have continued to develop through their respective club environments and international opportunities.

news.title: Luis de la Fuente wins Men's Coach of the Year after Spain's World Cup triumph
news.lede: Spain coach Luis de la Fuente has been named Men's Coach of the Year at the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony in London, following an extraordinary year in which he guided his country to World Cup glory.The 65 year old received the prestigious honour after leading Spain to their second FIFA World Cup title, defeating defending champions Argentina 1-0 in a dramatic final on July 19. Ferran Torres scored the winner in the 106th minute as Spain lifted the trophy for the first time since 2010. Accepting the award, De la Fuente was quick to share the credit with his players and coaching staff." Good evening, it is a real honour for me to receive this prize," he said."

news.title: FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival 2026 - Final points table after Senegal U-15 vs India U-15 in Group K
news.lede: Blue Colts slip to Tier C after humiliating defeat to Senegal in final matchweek The Hovsan Competition Complex in Baku, Azerbaijan, geared up to host the final matchweek fixtures in Group K of the FIFA U-15 World Cup and Festival, where the Indian U15 team, led by Bibiano Fernandes, locked horns with Bahrain U15. India were up against Senegal tonight. India’s qualification in Tier A had the easiest permutation. Three teams were in contention for the top spot and India who were atop the points table with 10 points were just a win away from qualifying for Tier A.

news.title: England Under-15s walk off pitch against Ireland in World Cup after racism allegation
news.lede: Match in new Fifa competition abandoned. England players refuse to resume match. England abandoned their Under-15 World Cup match against the Republic of Ireland on Monday after a player reported being subjected to a racist slur. Fifa confirmed it was investigating what happened in the final minute of the Group C fixture in Baku, Azerbaijan, when Ireland were leading 4-1.

news.title: FIFA issue statement as England walk off pitch at U15 World Cup after alleged racism
news.lede: FIFA are investigating an allegation of racist abuse by a Republic of Ireland player that led to the abandonment of England's Under-15 World Cup match. The incident took place during Monday's match in Azerbaijan, when an England player was seen approaching the touchline to inform his coaching staff of the alleged abuse, before the complaint was brought to the referee's attention. England's coaching staff then instructed their players to leave the pitch, with the Republic of Ireland leading 4-1 heading into the final minute of the match. FIFA have since confirmed they are investigating the incident and gathering reports to establish the circumstances surrounding the allegation.
